mnd14:177.2: attānaṃ vā nīcaṃ ṭhapento paraṃ uccaṃ ṭhapento janaṃ lapati, attānaṃ vā uccaṃ ṭhapento paraṃ nīcaṃ ṭhapento janaṃ lapati.

mnd14:177.4: Tumhe me bahūpakārā, ahaṃ tumhe nissāya labhāmi cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ, ye pi me aññe dātuṃ vā kātuṃ vā maññanti tumhe nissāya tumhe sampassantā; yam pi purāṇaṃ mātāpitikaṃ nāmadheyyaṃ, tam pi me antarahitaṃ;
mnd14:177.5: tumhehi ahañ ñāyāmi asukassa kulupako, asukāya kulupako ti;
mnd14:177.6: evaṃ attānaṃ nīcaṃ ṭhapento paraṃ uccaṃ ṭhapento janaṃ lapati.
mnd14:178.1: Kathaṃ attānaṃ uccaṃ ṭhapento paraṃ nīcaṃ ṭhapento janaṃ lapati?
mnd14:178.2: Ahaṃ tumhākaṃ bahūpakāro, tumhe maṃ āgamma Buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ gatā, dhammaṃ saraṇaṃ gatā saṃghaṃ saraṇaṃ gatā, pāṇātipātā paṭiviratā, adinnādānāpaṭiviratā, kāmesu micchācārā paṭiviratā, musāvādā paṭiviratā, surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭiviratā;
mnd14:178.3: ahaṃ tumhākaṃ uddesaṃ demi, paripucchaṃ demi, uposathaṃ ācikkhāmi, navakammaṃ adhiṭṭhāmi;
mnd14:178.4: atha ca pana tumhe maṃ ussajjitvā aññe sakkarotha garukarotha mānetha pūjethā ti,
mnd14:178.5: evam pi attānaṃ uccaṃ ṭhapento paraṃ nīcaṃ ṭhapento janaṃ lapati.
mnd14:179.2: lābhahetu lābhakāraṇā lābhābhinibbattiyā lābhaṃ paripācento janaṃ na lapayeyya lapanaṃ pajaheyya vinodeyya byantīkareyya anabhāvaṃ gameyya; ālapanā ārato assa virato paṭivirato nikkhanto nissaṭṭho vippamutto visaṃyutto vimariyādikatena cetasā vihareyyā ti,
mnd14:183.1: Na ca katthitā siyā bhikkhū ti.
mnd14:183.3: So katthati, aham asmi sīlasampanno ti vā, vatasampanno ti vā, sīlabbatasampanno ti vā, jātiyā vā gottena vā kolaputtikena vā vaṇṇapokkharatāya vā dhanena vā kammāyatanena vā sippāyatanena vā vijjaṭṭhānena vā sutena vā paṭibhāṇena vā aññataraññatarena vā vatthunā
mnd14:183.4: uccākulā pabbajito ti vā mahābhogakulā pabbajito ti vā uḷārabhogakulā pabbajito ti vā
mnd14:183.5: suttantiko ti vā vinayadharo ti vā dhammakathiko ti vā āraññiko ti vā . . . pe . . .
mnd14:183.6: nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasamāpattiyā lābhī ti vā katthati vikatthati;
mnd14:183.7: evaṃ na vikattheyya vikatthaṃ pajaheyya vinodeyya byantīkareyya anabhāvaṃ gameyya, katthanā ārato assa virato paṭivirato nikkhanto nissaṭṭho vippamutto visaṃyutto vimariyādikatena cetasā vihareyyā ti,
mnd14:184.1: Na ca vācaṃ payuttaṃ bhāseyyā ti.
mnd14:184.3: Idh' ekacco cīvarapayuttaṃ vācaṃ bhāsati, piṇḍapātapayuttaṃ vācaṃ bhāsati, senāsanapayuttaṃ vācaṃ bhāsati, gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārapayuttaṃ vācaṃ bhāsati;
mnd14:185.1: Athavā cīvarahetu piṇḍapātahetu senāsanahetu gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārahetu saccam pi bhaṇati, musā pi bhaṇati, pisuṇam pi bhaṇati, apisuṇam pi bhaṇati, pharusam pi bhaṇati, apharusam pi bhaṇati, samphappalāpam pi bhanati, asamphappalāpam pi bhaṇati, mantā pi vācaṃ bhāsati;
mnd14:185.4: aho vata me dhammaṃ suṇeyyuṃ, sutvā ca dhammaṃ pasīdeyyuṃ, pasannā ca me pasannākāraṃ kareyyun ti;
mnd14:185.6: Na ca vācaṃ payuttaṃ bhāseyyā ti
mnd14:185.7: antamaso dhammadesanāvācaṃ upādāya payuttavācaṃ na bhāseyya na katheyya na bhaṇeyya na dīpayeyya na vohareyya payuttavācaṃ pajaheyya vinodeyya byantīkareyya anabhāvaṃ gameyya; payuttavācāya ārato assa virato paṭivirato nikkhanto nissaṭṭho vippamutto visaṃyutto vimariyādikatena cetasā vihareyyā ti,
mnd14:186.3: kāyikaṃ pāgabbhiyaṃ, vācasikaṃ pāgabbhiyaṃ, cetasikaṃ pāgabbhiyaṃ.
mnd14:186.5: Idh' ekacco saṃghagato pi kāyikaṃ pāgabbhiyaṃ dasseti, gaṇagato pi kāyikaṃ pāgabbhiyaṃ dasseti, bhojanasālāya pi kāyikaṃ pāgabbhiyaṃ dasseti, jantāghare pi kāyikaṃ pāgabbhiyaṃ dasseti, udakatitthe pi kāyikaṃ pāgabbhiyaṃ dasseti, antaragharaṃ pavisanto pi kāyikaṃ pāgabbhiyaṃ dasseti, antaragharaṃ paviṭṭho pi kāyikaṃ pāgabbhiyaṃ dasseti.
mnd14:187.2: Idh' ekacco saṃghagato acittikārakato there bhikkhū ghaṭṭayanto pi tiṭṭhati, ghaṭṭayanto pi nisīdati, purato pi tiṭṭhati, purato pi nisīdati, ucce pi āsane nisīdati, sasīsaṃ pārupitvā pi nisīdati, ṭhitako pi bhaṇati, bāhāvikkhepako pi bhaṇati;
mnd14:188.2: Idh' ekacco gaṇagato acittikārakato therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ anupāhanānaṃ caṅkamantānaṃ, sa-upāhano caṅkamati, nīce caṅkamantānaṃ ucce caṅkame caṅkamati, chamāyaṃ caṅkamantānaṃ caṅkame caṅkamati, ghaṭṭayanto pi tiṭṭhati, ghaṭṭayanto pi nisīdati, purato pi tiṭṭhati, purato pi nisīdati, ucce pi āsane nisīdati, sasīsaṃ pārupitvā pi nisīdati, ṭhitako pi bhaṇati, bāhāvikkhepako pi bhaṇati;
mnd14:189.2: Idh' ekacco bhojanasālāya acittikārakato there bhikkhū anupakhajja nisīdati, nave pi bhikkhū āsanena paṭibāhati, ghaṭṭayanto pi tiṭṭhati, ghaṭṭayanto pi nisīdati, purato pi tiṭṭhati, purato pi nisīdati, ucce pi āsane nisīdati, sasīsaṃ pārupitvā pi nisīdati, ṭhitako pi bhaṇati, bāhāvikkhepako pi bhaṇati;
mnd14:190.2: Idh' ekacco jantāghare acittikārakato there bhikkhū ghaṭṭayanto pi tiṭṭhati, ghaṭṭayanto pi nisīdati, purato pi tiṭṭhati, purato pi nisīdati, ucce pi āsane nisīdati, anāpucchā pi kaṭṭhaṃ pakkhipati, anāpucchā pi dvāraṃ pidahati;
mnd14:191.2: Idh' ekacco udakatitthe acittikārakato there bhikkhū ghaṭṭayanto pi otarati, purato pi otarati, ghaṭṭayanto pi nhāyati, purato pi nhāyati, upari pi nhāyati, ghaṭṭayanto pi uttarati, purato pi uttarati;
mnd14:192.1: Kathaṃ antaragharaṃ pavisanto kāyikaṃ pāgabbhiyaṃ dasseti?
mnd14:192.2: Idh' ekacco antaragharaṃ pavisanto acittikārakato there bhikkhū ghaṭṭayanto pi gacchati, purato pi gacchati, vokkamma pi therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ purato gacchati,
mnd14:192.3: evaṃ antaragharaṃ pavisanto kāyikaṃ pāgabbhiyaṃ dasseti.
mnd14:193.1: Kathaṃ antaragharaṃ paviṭṭho kāyikaṃ pāgabbhiyaṃ dasseti?
mnd14:193.2: Idh' ekacco antaragharaṃ paviṭṭho na pavisa bhante ti vuccamāno pavisati, na tiṭṭha bhante ti vuccamāno tiṭṭhati, na nisīda bhante ti vuccamāno nisīdati, anokāsam pi pavisati, anokāse pi tiṭṭhati, anokāse pi nisīdati; yāni tāni honti kulānaṃ ovarakāni gūḷhāni ca paṭicchannāni ca, yattha kulitthiyo kuladhītāyo kulasuṇhāyo kulakumāriyo nisīdanti, tattha pi sahasā pavisati, kumārakassa pi sīsaṃ parāmasati;
mnd14:193.3: evaṃ antaragharaṃ paviṭṭho kāyikaṃ pāgabbhiyaṃ dasseti;
mnd14:194.2: Idh' ekacco saṃghagato pi vācasikaṃ pāgabbhiyaṃ dasseti, gaṇagato pi vācasikaṃ pāgabbhiyaṃ dasseti, antaragharaṃ paviṭṭho pi vācasikaṃ pāgabbhiyaṃ dasseti.
mnd14:194.4: Idh' ekacco saṃghagato acittikārakato there bhikkhū anāpucchā vā anajjhiṭṭho vā ārāmagatānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ dhammaṃ bhaṇati, pañhaṃ visajjeti, pātimokkhaṃ uddisati, ṭhitako pi bhaṇati, bāhāvikkhepako pi bhaṇati;
mnd14:195.2: Idh' ekacco gaṇagato acittikārakato there bhikkhū anāpucchā vā anajjhiṭṭho vā ārāmagatānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ dhammaṃ bhaṇati, pañhaṃ visajjeti ṭhitako pi bhaṇati; bāhāvikkhepako pi bhaṇati;
mnd14:195.3: ārāmagatānaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ upāsakānaṃ upāsikānaṃ dhammaṃ bhaṇati, pañhaṃ visajjeti, ṭhitako pi bhaṇati, bahāvikkhepako pi bhaṇati;
mnd14:196.1: Kathaṃ antaragharaṃ paviṭṭho vācasikaṃ pāgabbhiyaṃ dasseti?
mnd14:196.2: Idh' ekacco antaragharaṃ paviṭṭho itthiṃ vā kumāriṃ vā āha:
mnd14:196.4: Yāgū atthi, bhattaṃ atthi, khādanīyaṃ atthi?
mnd14:196.5: Kiṃ pivissāma, kiṃ bhuñjissāma, kiṃ khādissāma, kiṃ vā atthi, kiṃ vā me dassathā? ti vilappati;
mnd14:196.6: evaṃ antaragharaṃ paviṭṭho vācasikaṃ pāgabbhiyaṃ dasseti;
mnd14:197.2: Idh' ekacco na uccākulā pabbajito samāno uccākulā pabbajitena saddhiṃ sadisaṃ attānaṃ karoti cittena,
mnd14:197.3: na mahākulā pabbajito samāno, na mahābhogakulā pabbajito samāno,
mnd14:197.4: na uḷārabhogakulā pabbajito samāno uḷārabhogakulā pabbajitena saddhiṃ sadisaṃ attānaṃ karoti cittena;
mnd14:197.5: na suttantiko samāno suttantikena saddhiṃ sadisaṃ attānaṃ karoti cittena;
mnd14:197.15: na yathāsanthatiko samāno yathāsanthatikena saddhiṃ sadisaṃ attānaṃ karoti cittena;
mnd14:197.16: na paṭhamassa jhānassa lābhī samāno paṭhamassa jhānassa lābhinā saddhiṃ sadisaṃ attānaṃ karoti cittena;
mnd14:197.23: na nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasamāpattiyā lābhī samāno nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasamāpattiyā lābhinā saddhiṃ sadisaṃ attānaṃ karoti cittena;
mnd14:197.25: Pāgabbhiyaṃ na sikkheyyā ti; pāgabbhiyaṃ na sikkheyya na ācareyya na samācareyya na samādāya vatteyya,
mnd14:197.26: pāgabbhiyaṃ pajaheyya vinodeyya byantīkareyya anabhāvaṃ gameyya; pāgabbhiyā ārato assa virato paṭivirato nikkhanto nissaṭṭho vippamutto visaṃyutto vimariyādikatena cetasā vihareyyā ti,
mnd14:198.3: Idh' ekacco evarūpiṃ kathaṃ kattā hoti,
mnd14:198.4: na tvaṃ imaṃ dhammavinayaṃ ājānāsi . . . pe . . .
mnd14:198.5: nibbedhehi vā sace pahosī ti. Vuttaṃ h'
mnd14:198.7: *Viggāhikāya kho Moggallāna kathāya sati kathābāhullaṃ pāṭikaṃkhaṃ, kathābāhulle sati uddhaccaṃ, uddhatassa asaṃvaro, asaṃvutassa ārā cittaṃ samādhimhā ti.
mnd14:198.9: viggāhikakathaṃ na katheyya na bhaṇeyya na dīpayeyya na vohareyya, viggāhikakathaṃ pajaheyya vinodeyya byantīkareyya anabhāvaṃ gameyya; viggāhikakathāya ārato assa virato paṭivirato nikkhanto nissaṭṭho vippamutto visaṃyutto vimariyādikatena cetasā vihareyyā ti,
mnd14:202.3: Idh' ekacco sabhaggato vā parisaggato vā . . . pe . . .
mnd14:202.6: Api ca tīh' ākārehi musāvādo hoti,
mnd14:202.7: pubb'eva tassa hoti musā bhaṇissan ti, bhaṇantassa hoti musā bhaṇāmī ti, bhaṇitassa hoti musā mayā bhaṇitan ti; imehi tīh' ākārehi musāvādo hoti.
mnd14:202.14: pubb'eva tassa hoti musā bhaṇissan ti, bhaṇantassa hoti musā bhaṇamī ti, bhaṇitassa hoti musā mayā bhaṇitan ti, vinidhāya diṭṭhiṃ vinidhāya khantiṃ vinidhāya ruciṃ vinidhāya saññaṃ vinidhāya bhāvaṃ;
mnd14:202.17: mosavajje na niyyeyya, mosavajjaṃ pajaheyya vinodeyya byantīkareyya anabhāvaṃ gameyya; mosavajjā ārato assa virato paṭivirato nikkhanto nissaṭṭho vippamutto visaṃyutto vimariyādikatena cetasā vihareyyā ti,
mnd14:203.3: Idh' ekacco saṭho hoti parisaṭho. Yaṃ tattha saṭhaṃ saṭhatā sāṭheyyaṃ, kakkaritā kakkariyaṃ parikkhattatā parikattiyaṃ;
mnd14:203.6: sampajāno hutvā sāṭheyyaṃ na kareyya na janeyya na sañjaneyya na nibbatteyya nābhinibbatteyya; sāṭheyyaṃ pajaheyya vinodeyya byantīkareyya anabhāvaṃ gameyya sāṭheyyā ārato assa virato paṭivirato nikkhanto nissaṭṭho vippamutto visaṃyutto vimariyādikatena cetasā vihareyyā ti,
mnd14:204.1: Atha jīvitena paññāya sīlabbatena nāññaṃ atimaññe ti.
mnd14:204.4: Idh' ekacco lūkhajīvikaṃ jīvanto paraṃ paṇītajīvikaṃ jīvantaṃ atimaññati:
mnd14:204.5: kiṃ panāyaṃ bahullājīvo sabbaṃ saṃbhakkhati, seyyathīdaṃ
mnd14:204.6: mūlabījaṃ khandhabījaṃ phalubījaṃ aggabījaṃ bījabījam eva pañcamaṃ asavicakkadantakuṭasamāṇappadhanātiṇṇo? ti.
mnd14:204.7: So tāya lūkhajīvikāya paraṃ paṇītajīvikaṃ jīvantaṃ atimaññati.
mnd14:205.1: Idh' ekacco paṇītajīvikaṃ jīvanto paraṃ lūkhajīvikaṃ jīvantaṃ atimaññati:
mnd14:205.2: kiṃ panāyaṃ appapuñño appesakkho na lābhī cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānan? ti.
mnd14:205.3: So tāya paṇītajīvikāya paraṃ lūkhajīvikaṃ jīvantaṃ atimaññati.
mnd14:205.7: aham asmi paññāsampanno, ime pan' aññe na paññāsampannā ti.
mnd14:205.9: Idh' ekacco sīlasampanno hoti, pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati, ācāragocarasampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu.
mnd14:205.11: aham asmi sīlasampanno, ime pan' aññe bhikkhū dussīlā pāpadhammā ti.
mnd14:205.13: Idh' ekacco vattasampanno āraññiko vā piṇḍapātiko vā paṃsukūliko vā tecīvariko vā khalupacchābhattiko vā nesajjiko vā yathāsanthatiko vā.
mnd14:205.15: aham asmi vattasampanno, ime pan' aññe na vattasampannā ti.
mnd14:205.16: So tāya vattasampadāya paraṃ atimaññatī ti,
mnd14:205.17: atha jīvitena paññāya sīlabbattena. Nāññam atimaññe ti
mnd14:205.18: lūkhajīvikāya vā paṇītajīvikāya vā paññāsampadāya vā sīlasampadāya vā vattasampadāya vā paraṃ nātimaññeyya nāvajāneyya na tena mānaṃ janeyya, na tena thaddho assa patthaddho paggahitasiro ti,
mnd14:205.19: atha jīvitena paññāya sīlabbatena nāññam atimaññe.
mnd14:209.1: Sutvā dūsito bahuṃ vācaṃ samaṇānaṃ vā puthuvacanānan ti.
mnd14:209.2: Dūsito ti dūsito khuṃsito ghaṭṭito vambhito garahito upavadito.
mnd14:209.3: Samaṇānan ti ye keci ito bahiddhā paribbājupagatā paribbājasamāpannā.
mnd14:209.4: Puthuvacanānan ti khattiyā ca brāhmaṇā ca vessā ca suddā ca gahaṭṭhā ca pabbajitā ca devā ca manussā ca. Te bahukāhi vācāhi aniṭṭhāhi akantāhi amanāpāhi akkoseyyuṃ paribhāseyyuṃ roseyyuṃ viroseyyuṃ heṭheyyuṃ viheṭheyyuṃ ghāteyyuṃ upaghāteyyuṃ upaghātaṃ kareyyuṃ. Tesaṃ bahuṃ vācaṃ aniṭṭhaṃ akantaṃ amanāpaṃ sutvā suṇitvā uggahitvā upadhārayitvā upalakkhitvā ti,
mnd14:209.5: sutvā dūsito bahuṃ vācaṃ samaṇānaṃ vā puthuvacanānaṃ.
mnd14:210.2: Pharusenā ti pharusena kakkhaḷena. Na pativajjā ti na patibhaṇeyya akkosantaṃ na paccakkoseyya, rosantaṃ na patiroseyya, bhaṇḍanaṃ na patibhaṇḍeyya, na kalahaṃ kareyya, na bhaṇḍanaṃ kareyya, na viggahaṃ kareyya, na vivādaṃ kareyya, na medhagaṃ kareyya, kalahabhaṇḍanaviggahavivādamedhagaṃ pajaheyya vinodeyya byantīkareyya anabhāvaṃgameyya , kalahabhaṇḍanaviggahavivādamedhagā ārato assa virato paṭivirato nikkhanto nissaṭṭho vippamutto visaṃyutto vimariyādikatena cetasā vihareyyā ti,
mnd14:211.2: Santo ti rāgassa santattā santo, dosassa mohassa kodhassa upanāhassa . . . pe . . . sabbākusalābhisaṃkhārānaṃ santattā samitattā vūpasamitattā vijjhātattā nibbutattā vigatattā paṭipassaddhattā santo upasanto vūpasanto nibbuto paṭipassaddho ti,
mnd14:211.5: santo paṭiseniṃ paṭimallaṃ paṭikaṇṭaṃ na karonti paṭipakkhaṃ na karonti na janenti na sañjanenti na nibbattenti nābhinibbattentī ti,
mnd14:215.2: Etan ti ācikkhitaṃ desitaṃ paññāpitaṃ paṭṭhapitaṃ vivaṭaṃ vibhattaṃ uttānīkataṃ pakāsitaṃ. Dhammam aññāyā ti jānitvā tulayitvā tīrayitvā vibhāvayitvā vibhūtaṃ katvā ti,
mnd14:215.3: evam pi etañ ca dhammam aññāya.
mnd14:215.4: Athavā samañ ca visamañ ca pathañ ca vipathañ ca sāvajjañ ca anavajjañ ca hīnañ ca paṇītañ ca kaṇhañ ca sukkañ ca viññūgarahitañ ca viññūpasaṭṭhañ ca dhammaṃ aññāya jānitvā tulayitvā tīrayitvā vibhāvayitvā vibhūtaṃ katvā ti,
mnd14:215.5: evam pi etañ ca dhammam aññāya.
mnd14:215.6: Athavā sammāpaṭipadaṃ anulomapaṭipadaṃ apaccanīkapaṭipadaṃ dhammānudhammapaṭipadaṃ sīlesu paripūrikāritaṃ indriyesu guttadvārataṃ bhojane mattaññutaṃ jāgariyānuyogaṃ satisampajaññaṃ cattāro satipaṭṭhāne cattāro sammappadhāne cattāro iddhippāde pañc' indriyāni pañca balāni satta bojjhaṅge ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ nibbānañ ca nibbānagāminiñ ca paṭipadaṃ dhammaṃ aññāya jānitvā tulayitvā tīrayitvā vibhāvayitvā vibhūtaṃ katvā ti,
mnd14:215.7: evam pi etañ ca dhammam aññāya.
mnd14:216.1: Vicinaṃ bhikkhu sadā sato sikkhe ti.
mnd14:216.2: Vicinan ti vicinanto pavicinanto tulayanto tīrayanto vibhāvayanto vibhūtaṃ karonto.
mnd14:216.4: yaṃkiñci samudayadhammaṃ sabban taṃ nirodhadhamman ti vicinanto pavicinanto tulayanto tīrayanto vibhāvayanto vibhūtaṃ karonto ti,
mnd14:216.6: Sadā ti sadā sabbadā sabbakālaṃ . . . pe . . .
